series.title: Make the bar yours
series.sub: Presets, size, shape, colour and where it sits
series.next: Keep it out of the way

steps.title: Open Appearance
steps.text: In Gesture Volume, tap Appearance. The preview at the top shows the bar on a phone.

steps.title: Start from a preset
steps.text: Quick presets set the whole look at once: Classic, Dock, Edge and Bold.

steps.title: Size and shape
steps.text: Open Size & shape and drag Width and Height. Rounded or Tab sets how the ends look.

steps.title: Pick a colour
steps.text: Under Colours, tap Fill and choose a colour. The preview takes it straight away.

steps.title: Choose a side
steps.text: Under Position, put it on the left or the right, and set how far down the edge it sits.

steps.title: Save it
steps.text: Tap Save. Go home, and your bar is on the edge just as you made it.
